lessonTitle: 37. Volumes of the cylinder, cone and truncated cone
lessonTitleEnglish: Volumes of the cylinder, cone and truncated cone
unit: Geometry · Chapter 9. Volumes and surfaces of solids of revolution
source: Based on the topics of the Armenian grade 12 mathematics textbooks (advanced stream)

stages.headline: Cylinder: V = πr²h; cone: V = ⅓ πr²h.
stages.headlineEnglish: Cylinder: V = πr²h; cone: V = ⅓ πr²h.

stages.headline: A truncated cone has volume V = ⅓ πh (R² + Rr + r²).
stages.headlineEnglish: A truncated cone has volume V = ⅓ πh (R² + Rr + r²).

stages.headline: Example: R = 4, r = 2, h = 3 give V = ⅓ π · 3 · (16 + 8 + 4) = 28π.
stages.headlineEnglish: Example: R = 4, r = 2, h = 3 give V = ⅓ π · 3 · (16 + 8 + 4) = 28π.
